undergarment.definition: n. a garment worn under other garments

undergarments.definition: n. a garment worn under other garments
undergarments.translation: n. 内衣, 贴身衣( undergarment的复数形式 )

undergird.definition:
v. lend moral support to
v. make secure underneath
undergird.translation: vt. 从底层加固, 支持, 加强

undergirded.definition:
v lend moral support to
v make secure underneath
undergirded.translation: v. 在底部加固( undergird的过去式 ); 从底层支撑; 加强; 支持

undergirding.definition:
v lend moral support to
v make secure underneath
undergirding.translation: v. 在底部加固( undergird的现在分词 ); 从底层支撑; 加强; 支持

v lend moral support to
v make secure underneath

underglaze.definition:
a. Applied under the glaze, that is, before the glaze,
   that is, before the glaze is put on; fitted to be so applied; -- said
   of colors in porcelain painting.

undergo.translation:
vt. 遭受, 经历, 忍受
[法] 经受, 经历, 忍受

undergo a prison sentence.translation: [法] 受到监禁判处, 被判徒刑

undergoes.translation: v. 经历, 承受( undergo的第三人称单数 )

undergoing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Undergo
undergoing.translation: v. 经历, 承受( undergo的现在分词 )

undergown.definition:
n. A gown worn under another, or under some other article
   of dress.

undergrad.definition: n a university student who has not yet received a first degree
undergrad.translation:
n. 大学肄业生, 尚未取得学位的大学生
a. 大学生的

undergrads.definition:
plural of undergrad
n a university student who has not yet received a first degree

undergraduate.definition: n. a university student who has not yet received a first degree
undergraduate.translation:
n. 大学本科生, 大学肄业生
a. 大学生的

undergraduates.definition: n. a university student who has not yet received a first degree
undergraduates.translation: n. （未获学士学位的）大学生, 大学肄业生( undergraduate的复数形式 ); 本科生

underground.definition:
n. a secret group organized to overthrow a government or occupation force
r. in or into hiding or secret operation
r. beneath the surface of the earth
underground.translation:
n. 地下, 地铁, 地道, 秘密活动
a. 地下的, 秘密的
adv. 在地下, 秘密地

underground tank.translation: [化] 地下储罐; 地下储油罐

undergrounder.definition:
s under the level of the ground
s conducted with or marked by hidden aims or methods
undergrounder.translation: n. 在地面下工作的人, 秘密组织成员, 地下铁道乘客

undergrounding.definition:
-ing form of underground

r. in or into hiding or secret operation
r. beneath the surface of the earth

(underground 的现在分词) n. 地下, 地铁, 地道, 秘密活动
a. 地下的, 秘密的

undergrove.definition: n. A grove of shrubs or low trees under taller ones.

undergrown.definition: a. Of small stature; not grown to a full height or size.
undergrown.translation: a. 发育不全的, 有林下灌木的

undergrowth.definition: n the brush (small trees and bushes and ferns etc.) growing beneath taller trees in a wood or forest
undergrowth.translation: n. 下层丛林, 生于大树下的矮树, 发育不全

undergrowths.definition:
plural of undergrowth
n the brush (small trees and bushes and ferns etc.) growing beneath taller trees in a wood or forest
undergrowths.translation: (undergrowth 的复数) n. 下层丛林, 生于大树下的矮树, 发育不全
